title: "The Steuart Building, home of the Photo-Intelligence Division" (Chapter 2, p. 83)
description: Black-and-white street-level photograph of a multistory brick commercial building with parked cars along the street in front. Captioned "The Steuart Building, home of the Photo-Intelligence Division." The text notes the PID moved to the Steuart Building at 5th Street and New York Avenue, NW, by summer 1956 to handle U-2 photography.
